passages.text: The Israelites, however, acted unfaithfully regarding the things devoted to destruction. Achan son of Carmi, the son of Zabdi, the son of Zerah, of the tribe of Judah, took some of what was set apart. So the anger of the LORD burned against the Israelites.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites acted unfaithfully.
They did not obey God about the things devoted to destruction.
A man named Achan took some of what was set apart for God.
Achan was the son of Carmi.
Carmi was the son of Zabdi.
Zabdi was the son of Zerah.
They were from the tribe of Judah.
Because of this, the LORD became angry with the Israelites.
passages.original: וַיִּמְעֲל֧וּ בְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל מַ֖עַל בַּחֵ֑רֶם וַיִּקַּ֡ח עָכָ֣ן בֶּן־ כַּרְמִי֩ בֶן־ זַבְדִּ֨י בֶן־ זֶ֜רַח לְמַטֵּ֤ה יְהוּדָה֙ מִן־ הַחֵ֔רֶם וַיִּֽחַר־ אַ֥ף יְהוָ֖ה בִּבְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: Meanwhile, Joshua sent men from Jericho to Ai, which is near Beth-aven to the east of Bethel, and told them, “Go up and spy out the land.” So the men went up and spied out Ai.
passages.sermon:
Joshua was the leader of Israel.
Joshua sent men from Jericho.
He sent them to the city of Ai.
Ai is near Beth-aven.
Beth-aven is east of Bethel.
Joshua spoke to the men.
He said, “Go up and spy out the land.”
The men went up.
They spied out Ai.
passages.original: וַיִּשְׁלַח֩ יְהוֹשֻׁ֨עַ אֲנָשִׁ֜ים מִֽירִיח֗וֹ הָעַ֞י אֲשֶׁ֨ר עִם־ בֵּ֥ית אָ֙וֶן֙ מִקֶּ֣דֶם לְבֵֽית־ אֵ֔ל וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר עֲל֖וּ וְרַגְּל֣וּ אֶת־ הָאָ֑רֶץ וַֽיַּעֲלוּ֙ הָאֲנָשִׁ֔ים וַֽיְרַגְּל֖וּ אֶת־ הָעָֽי׃

passages.text: On returning to Joshua, they reported, “There is no need to send all the people; two or three thousand men are enough to go up and attack Ai. Since the people of Ai are so few, you need not wear out all our people there.”
passages.sermon:
The men returned to Joshua.
They spoke to Joshua.
They said, “Do not send all the people.”
They said, “Send about two thousand or three thousand men.”
They said, “Let these men go up and attack Ai.”
They said, “Do not make all the people go there.”
They said, “The people of Ai are few.”
passages.original: וַיָּשֻׁ֣בוּ אֶל־ יְהוֹשֻׁ֗עַ וַיֹּאמְר֣וּ אֵלָיו֮ אַל־ יַ֣עַל כָּל־ הָעָם֒ כְּאַלְפַּ֣יִם אִ֗ישׁ א֚וֹ כִּשְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֣ים אִ֔ישׁ יַעֲל֖וּ וְיַכּ֣וּ אֶת־ הָעָ֑י אַל־ תְּיַגַּע־ שָׁ֙מָּה֙ אֶת־ כָּל־ הָעָ֔ם כִּ֥י מְעַ֖ט הֵֽמָּה׃

passages.text: So about three thousand men went up, but they fled before the men of Ai.
passages.sermon:
Joshua led the people of Israel.
He sent about three thousand men to Ai.
These men went up toward Ai.
The men of Israel faced the men of Ai.
The men of Israel fled from the men of Ai.
passages.original: וַיַּעֲל֤וּ מִן־ הָעָם֙ שָׁ֔מָּה כִּשְׁלֹ֥שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֖ים אִ֑ישׁ וַיָּנֻ֕סוּ לִפְנֵ֖י אַנְשֵׁ֥י הָעָֽי׃

passages.text: And the men of Ai struck down about thirty-six of them, chasing them from the gate as far as the quarries and striking them down on the slopes. So the hearts of the people melted and became like water.
passages.sermon:
The men of Ai attacked the Israelites.
They killed about thirty-six Israelites.
The men of Ai chased the Israelites from the city gate.
They chased them as far as the quarries.
The men of Ai struck down the Israelites on the slopes.
The hearts of the Israelites melted with fear.
Their courage disappeared like water.
passages.original: וַיַּכּ֨וּ מֵהֶ֜ם אַנְשֵׁ֣י הָעַ֗י כִּשְׁלֹשִׁ֤ים וְשִׁשָּׁה֙ אִ֔ישׁ וַֽיִּרְדְּפ֞וּם לִפְנֵ֤י הַשַּׁ֙עַר֙ עַד־ הַשְּׁבָרִ֔ים וַיַּכּ֖וּם בַּמּוֹרָ֑ד וַיִּמַּ֥ס לְבַב־ הָעָ֖ם וַיְהִ֥י לְמָֽיִם׃

passages.text: Then Joshua tore his clothes and fell facedown before the ark of the LORD until evening, as did the elders of Israel; and they all sprinkled dust on their heads.
passages.sermon:
Joshua was the leader of Israel.
Joshua tore his clothes.
Joshua fell facedown on the ground.
He lay before the ark of the LORD.
He stayed there until evening.
The elders of Israel were with him.
The elders also fell facedown.
They all put dust on their heads.
passages.original: וַיִּקְרַ֨ע יְהוֹשֻׁ֜עַ שִׂמְלֹתָ֗יו וַיִּפֹּל֩ עַל־ פָּנָ֨יו אַ֜רְצָה לִפְנֵ֨י אֲר֤וֹן יְהוָה֙ עַד־ הָעֶ֔רֶב ה֖וּא וְזִקְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיַּעֲל֥וּ עָפָ֖ר עַל־ רֹאשָֽׁם׃

passages.text: “O, Lord GOD,” Joshua said, “why did You ever bring this people across the Jordan to deliver us into the hand of the Amorites to be destroyed? If only we had been content to stay on the other side of the Jordan!
passages.sermon:
Joshua was the leader of Israel.
Joshua spoke to the Lord God.
Joshua said, “O Lord God, why did You bring this people across the Jordan River?
Did You bring us here to give us into the hand of the Amorites?
Did You bring us here so they could destroy us?
If only we had been willing to stay on the other side of the Jordan.
We could have remained there.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוֹשֻׁ֜עַ אֲהָ֣הּ׀ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֗ה לָ֠מָה הֵעֲבַ֨רְתָּ הַעֲבִ֜יר אֶת־ הָעָ֤ם הַזֶּה֙ אֶת־ הַיַּרְדֵּ֔ן לָתֵ֥ת אֹתָ֛נוּ בְּיַ֥ד הָאֱמֹרִ֖י לְהַאֲבִידֵ֑נוּ וְלוּ֙ הוֹאַ֣לְנוּ וַנֵּ֔שֶׁב בְּעֵ֖בֶר הַיַּרְדֵּֽן׃

passages.text: O Lord, what can I say, now that Israel has turned its back and run from its enemies?
passages.sermon:
Joshua was the leader of Israel.
Joshua spoke to the Lord.
Joshua said, “O Lord, what can I say?”
Israel has turned its back.
Israel ran away from its enemies.
passages.original: בִּ֖י אֲדֹנָ֑י מָ֣ה אֹמַ֔ר אַ֠חֲרֵי אֲשֶׁ֨ר הָפַ֧ךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל עֹ֖רֶף לִפְנֵ֥י אֹיְבָֽיו׃

passages.text: When the Canaanites and all who live in the land hear about this, they will surround us and wipe out our name from the earth. Then what will You do for Your great name?”
passages.sermon:
Joshua was the leader of Israel.
\r\nJoshua spoke to God.
\r\nJoshua said, “The Canaanites will hear about this.
\r\nAll the people who live in the land will also hear.
\r\nThey will come together against us.
\r\nThey will surround us.
\r\nThey will destroy our name from the earth.
\r\nWhat will You do for Your great name?”
passages.original: וְיִשְׁמְע֣וּ הַֽכְּנַעֲנִ֗י וְכֹל֙ יֹשְׁבֵ֣י הָאָ֔רֶץ וְנָסַ֣בּוּ עָלֵ֔ינוּ וְהִכְרִ֥יתוּ אֶת־ שְׁמֵ֖נוּ מִן־ הָאָ֑רֶץ וּמַֽה־ תַּעֲשֵׂ֖ה לְשִׁמְךָ֥ הַגָּדֽוֹל׃ס

passages.text: But the LORD said to Joshua, “Stand up! Why have you fallen on your face?
passages.sermon: The LORD spoke to Joshua.\r\nThe LORD said, "Stand up."\r\nThe LORD asked Joshua, "Why are you lying on your face?"
passages.original: וַיֹּ֧אמֶר יְהוָ֛ה אֶל־ יְהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ קֻ֣ם לָ֑ךְ לָ֣מָּה זֶּ֔ה אַתָּ֖ה נֹפֵ֥ל עַל־ פָּנֶֽיךָ׃

passages.text: Israel has sinned; they have transgressed My covenant that I commanded them, and they have taken some of what was devoted to destruction. Indeed, they have stolen and lied, and they have put these things with their own possessions.
passages.sermon:
Israel sinned.
Israel broke My covenant.
I commanded Israel to keep this covenant.
Israel took things that were devoted to destruction.
Israel stole these things.
Israel lied about it.
Israel hid these things among their own possessions.
passages.original: חָטָא֙ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְגַם֙ עָבְר֣וּ אֶת־ בְּרִיתִ֔י אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוִּ֖יתִי אוֹתָ֑ם וְגַ֤ם לָֽקְחוּ֙ מִן־ הַחֵ֔רֶם וְגַ֤ם גָּֽנְבוּ֙ וְגַ֣ם כִּֽחֲשׁ֔וּ וְגַ֖ם שָׂ֥מוּ בִכְלֵיהֶֽם׃

passages.text: This is why the Israelites cannot stand against their enemies. They will turn their backs and run from their enemies, because they themselves have been set apart for destruction. I will no longer be with you unless you remove from among you whatever is devoted to destruction.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites cannot stand against their enemies.
They will turn their backs and run from their enemies.
They do this because they have been set apart for destruction.
I will not stay with you any longer.
You must remove what is devoted to destruction from among you.
If you do not remove it, I will not be with you.
passages.original: וְלֹ֨א יֻכְל֜וּ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל לָקוּם֙ לִפְנֵ֣י אֹיְבֵיהֶ֔ם עֹ֗רֶף יִפְנוּ֙ לִפְנֵ֣י אֹֽיְבֵיהֶ֔ם כִּ֥י הָי֖וּ לְחֵ֑רֶם לֹ֤א אוֹסִיף֙ לִֽהְי֣וֹת עִמָּכֶ֔ם אִם־ לֹ֥א תַשְׁמִ֛ידוּ הַחֵ֖רֶם מִֽקִּרְבְּכֶֽם׃

passages.text: Get up and consecrate the people, saying, ‘Consecrate yourselves for tomorrow, for this is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: Among you, O Israel, there are things devoted to destruction. You cannot stand against your enemies until you remove them.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD spoke to Joshua.
The LORD said, “Get up.
Set the people apart for Me.
Tell the people, ‘Set yourselves apart for tomorrow.
This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says.
There are things among you, Israel, that are devoted to destruction.
You cannot stand against your enemies.
You must remove what is devoted to destruction from among you.
Only then can you stand against your enemies.’”
passages.original: קֻ֚ם קַדֵּ֣שׁ אֶת־ הָעָ֔ם וְאָמַרְתָּ֖ הִתְקַדְּשׁ֣וּ לְמָחָ֑ר כִּ֣י כֹה֩ אָמַ֨ר יְהוָ֜ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל חֵ֤רֶם בְּקִרְבְּךָ֙ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לֹ֣א תוּכַ֗ל לָקוּם֙ לִפְנֵ֣י אֹיְבֶ֔יךָ עַד־ הֲסִירְכֶ֥ם הַחֵ֖רֶם מִֽקִּרְבְּכֶֽם׃

passages.text: In the morning you must present yourselves tribe by tribe. The tribe that the LORD selects shall come forward clan by clan, and the clan that the LORD selects shall come forward family by family, and the family that the LORD selects shall come forward man by man.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of Israel.
He commands the Israelites to present themselves in the morning.
Each tribe must come forward.
The LORD will select one tribe.
The selected tribe must come forward by its clans.
The LORD will select one clan from that tribe.
The selected clan must come forward by its families.
The LORD will select one family from that clan.
The selected family must come forward man by man.
passages.original: וְנִקְרַבְתֶּ֥ם בַּבֹּ֖קֶר לְשִׁבְטֵיכֶ֑ם וְהָיָ֡ה הַשֵּׁבֶט֩ אֲשֶׁר־ יִלְכְּדֶ֨נּוּ יְהוָ֜ה יִקְרַ֣ב לַמִּשְׁפָּח֗וֹת וְהַמִּשְׁפָּחָ֞ה אֲשֶֽׁר־ יִלְכְּדֶ֤נָּה יְהוָה֙ תִּקְרַ֣ב לַבָּתִּ֔ים וְהַבַּ֙יִת֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִלְכְּדֶ֣נּוּ יְהוָ֔ה יִקְרַ֖ב לַגְּבָרִֽים׃

passages.text: The one who is caught with the things devoted to destruction must be burned, along with all that belongs to him, because he has transgressed the covenant of the LORD and committed an outrage in Israel.’ ”
passages.sermon:
The person who is caught with the things devoted to destruction must be punished.
The people must burn him with fire.
They must also burn everything that belongs to him.
He has broken the covenant of the LORD.
He has done a terrible thing in Israel.
passages.original: וְהָיָה֙ הַנִּלְכָּ֣ד בַּחֵ֔רֶם יִשָּׂרֵ֣ף בָּאֵ֔שׁ אֹת֖וֹ וְאֶת־ כָּל־ אֲשֶׁר־ ל֑וֹ כִּ֤י עָבַר֙ אֶת־ בְּרִ֣ית יְהוָ֔ה וְכִֽי־ עָשָׂ֥ה נְבָלָ֖ה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: So Joshua arose early the next morning and had Israel come forward tribe by tribe, and the tribe of Judah was selected.
passages.sermon:
Joshua was the leader of Israel.
Joshua got up early in the morning.
He gathered all the people of Israel.
He brought them forward tribe by tribe.
The tribe of Judah was chosen.
passages.original: וַיַּשְׁכֵּ֤ם יְהוֹשֻׁ֙עַ֙ בַּבֹּ֔קֶר וַיַּקְרֵ֥ב אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לִשְׁבָטָ֑יו וַיִּלָּכֵ֖ד שֵׁ֥בֶט יְהוּדָֽה׃

passages.text: He had the clans of Judah come forward, and the clan of the Zerahites was selected. He had the clan of the Zerahites come forward, and the family of Zabdi was selected.
passages.sermon:
Joshua led the people of Israel.
He brought forward the clans of Judah.
The clan of the Zerahites stood out among them.
Joshua brought the Zerahite clan forward, man by man.
The family of Zabdi was chosen from among them.
passages.original: וַיַּקְרֵב֙ אֶת־ מִשְׁפַּ֣חַת יְהוּדָ֔ה וַיִּלְכֹּ֕ד אֵ֖ת מִשְׁפַּ֣חַת הַזַּרְחִ֑י וַיַּקְרֵ֞ב אֶת־ מִשְׁפַּ֤חַת הַזַּרְחִי֙ לַגְּבָרִ֔ים וַיִּלָּכֵ֖ד זַבְדִּֽי׃

passages.text: And he had the family of Zabdi come forward man by man, and Achan son of Carmi, the son of Zabdi, the son of Zerah, of the tribe of Judah, was selected.
passages.sermon:
Joshua was the leader of Israel.
Joshua brought forward the family of Zabdi.
He called them one man at a time.
Achan was chosen.
Achan was the son of Carmi.
Carmi was the son of Zabdi.
Zabdi was the son of Zerah.
They belonged to the tribe of Judah.
passages.original: וַיַּקְרֵ֥ב אֶת־ בֵּית֖וֹ לַגְּבָרִ֑ים וַיִּלָּכֵ֗ד עָכָ֞ן בֶּן־ כַּרְמִ֧י בֶן־ זַבְדִּ֛י בֶּן־ זֶ֖רַח לְמַטֵּ֥ה יְהוּדָֽה׃

passages.text: So Joshua said to Achan, “My son, give glory to the LORD, the God of Israel, and make a confession to Him. I urge you to tell me what you have done; do not hide it from me.”
passages.sermon:
Joshua was the leader of Israel.
Achan was a man from the tribe of Judah.
Joshua spoke to Achan.
Joshua said, “My son, give glory to the LORD.
The LORD is the God of Israel.
Thank Him.
Tell me what you have done.
Do not hide anything from me.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוֹשֻׁ֜עַ אֶל־ עָכָ֗ן בְּנִי֙ שִֽׂים־ נָ֣א כָב֗וֹד לַֽיהוָ֛ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וְתֶן־ ל֣וֹ תוֹדָ֑ה וְהַגֶּד־ נָ֥א לִי֙ מֶ֣ה עָשִׂ֔יתָ אַל־ תְּכַחֵ֖ד מִמֶּֽנִּי׃

passages.text: “It is true,” Achan replied, “I have sinned against the LORD, the God of Israel. This is what I did: When I saw among the spoils a beautiful cloak from Shinar, two hundred shekels of silver, and a bar of gold weighing fifty shekels, I coveted them and took them. They are hidden in the ground inside my tent, with the silver underneath.”
passages.sermon:
Achan spoke to Joshua.
Achan said, “It is true.
I have sinned against the LORD, the God of Israel.
This is what I did.
I saw among the spoils a beautiful cloak from Shinar.
I saw two hundred shekels of silver.
I saw a bar of gold weighing fifty shekels.
I wanted them.
I took them.
They are hidden in the ground inside my tent.
The silver is underneath.”
passages.original: וַיַּ֧עַן עָכָ֛ן אֶת־ יְהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ וַיֹּאמַ֑ר אָמְנָ֗ה אָנֹכִ֤י חָטָ֙אתִי֙ לַֽיהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְכָזֹ֥את וְכָזֹ֖את עָשִֽׂיתִי׃ וָאֶרְאֶה בַשָּׁלָ֡ל אַדֶּ֣רֶת שִׁנְעָר֩ אַחַ֨ת טוֹבָ֜ה וּמָאתַ֧יִם שְׁקָלִ֣ים כֶּ֗סֶף וּלְשׁ֨וֹן זָהָ֤ב אֶחָד֙ חֲמִשִּׁ֤ים שְׁקָלִים֙ מִשְׁקָל֔וֹ וָֽאֶחְמְדֵ֖ם וָֽאֶקָּחֵ֑ם וְהִנָּ֨ם טְמוּנִ֥ים בָּאָ֛רֶץ בְּת֥וֹךְ הָאָֽהֳלִ֖י וְהַכֶּ֥סֶף תַּחְתֶּֽיהָ׃

passages.text: So Joshua sent messengers who ran to the tent, and there it all was, hidden in his tent, with the silver underneath.
passages.sermon:
Joshua was the leader of Israel.
Joshua sent messengers.
The messengers ran to Achan’s tent.
They looked inside the tent.
They found the stolen things hidden in the tent.
They saw the silver hidden underneath.
passages.original: וַיִּשְׁלַ֤ח יְהוֹשֻׁ֙עַ֙ מַלְאָכִ֔ים וַיָּרֻ֖צוּ הָאֹ֑הֱלָה וְהִנֵּ֧ה טְמוּנָ֛ה בְּאָהֳל֖וֹ וְהַכֶּ֥סֶף תַּחְתֶּֽיהָ׃

passages.text: They took the things from inside the tent, brought them to Joshua and all the Israelites, and spread them out before the LORD.
passages.sermon:
Joshua was the leader of Israel.
The messengers found the stolen things in Achan’s tent.
They took the things out of the tent.
They brought the things to Joshua.
They brought the things to all the Israelites.
They laid the things out before the LORD.
passages.original: וַיִּקָּחוּם֙ מִתּ֣וֹךְ הָאֹ֔הֶל וַיְבִאוּם֙ אֶל־ יְהוֹשֻׁ֔עַ וְאֶ֖ל כָּל־ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיַּצִּקֻ֖ם לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: Then Joshua, together with all Israel, took Achan son of Zerah, the silver, the cloak, the bar of gold, his sons and daughters, his oxen and donkeys and sheep, his tent, and everything else he owned, and brought them to the Valley of Achor.
passages.sermon:
Joshua was the leader of Israel.
Achan was the son of Zerah.
Achan had sinned against God.
Joshua took Achan.
Joshua took the silver.
Joshua took the cloak.
Joshua took the bar of gold.
Joshua took Achan’s sons.
Joshua took Achan’s daughters.
Joshua took Achan’s oxen.
Joshua took Achan’s donkeys.
Joshua took Achan’s sheep.
Joshua took Achan’s tent.
Joshua took everything Achan owned.
All Israel went with Joshua.
They brought Achan and all these things to the Valley of Achor.
passages.original: וַיִּקַּ֣ח יְהוֹשֻׁ֣עַ אֶת־ עָכָ֣ן בֶּן־ זֶ֡רַח וְאֶת־ הַכֶּ֣סֶף וְאֶת־ הָאַדֶּ֣רֶת וְֽאֶת־ לְשׁ֣וֹן הַזָּהָ֡ב וְֽאֶת־ בָּנָ֡יו וְֽאֶת־ בְּנֹתָ֡יו וְאֶת־ שׁוֹרוֹ֩ וְאֶת־ חֲמֹר֨וֹ וְאֶת־ צֹאנ֤וֹ וְאֶֽת־ אָהֳלוֹ֙ וְאֶת־ כָּל־ אֲשֶׁר־ ל֔וֹ וְכָל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל עִמּ֑וֹ וַיַּעֲל֥וּ אֹתָ֖ם עֵ֥מֶק עָכֽוֹר׃

passages.text: “Why have you brought this trouble upon us?” said Joshua. “Today the LORD will bring trouble upon you!” And all Israel stoned him to death. Then they stoned the others and burned their bodies.
passages.sermon:
Joshua was the leader of Israel.
Joshua spoke to Achan.
Joshua said, “Why did you bring trouble on us?”
Joshua said, “Today the LORD will bring trouble on you.”
All the Israelites stoned Achan to death with stones.
They burned the bodies of Achan and his family.
They also stoned the others with stones.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוֹשֻׁ֙עַ֙ מֶ֣ה עֲכַרְתָּ֔נוּ יַעְכֳּרְךָ֥ יְהוָ֖ה בַּיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֑ה וַיִּרְגְּמ֨וּ אֹת֤וֹ כָל־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֶ֔בֶן וַיִּשְׂרְפ֤וּ אֹתָם֙ בָּאֵ֔שׁ וַיִּסְקְל֥וּ אֹתָ֖ם בָּאֲבָנִֽים׃

passages.text: And they heaped over Achan a large pile of rocks that remains to this day. So the LORD turned from His burning anger. Therefore that place is called the Valley of Achor to this day.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites killed Achan because he sinned against God.
They placed a large pile of rocks over Achan.
This pile of rocks is still there today.
After this, the LORD stopped being angry.
People call that place the Valley of Achor.
It is still called the Valley of Achor today.
passages.original: וַיָּקִ֨ימוּ עָלָ֜יו גַּל־ אֲבָנִ֣ים גָּד֗וֹל עַ֚ד הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֔ה וַיָּ֥שָׁב יְהוָ֖ה מֵחֲר֣וֹן אַפּ֑וֹ עַל־ כֵּ֠ן קָרָ֞א שֵׁ֣ם הַמָּק֤וֹם הַהוּא֙ עֵ֣מֶק עָכ֔וֹר עַ֖ד הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃פ
